implementationBoundary.chapman: CHPMAN2 on ordinary DTAUC then serial REAL*8 TAUC and CH=(TAUC_prev+DTAUC/2)/CHP2

implementationBoundary.geometry: GEOFAST z_lay=0.5 with exact km->cm/reversal semantics
implementationBoundary.observerAerosol: consume ordinary runtime-assembled handoff; do not independently rebuild profile
implementationBoundary.radius: consume validated handoff value; frozen tested default is 6370.0 km
implementationBoundary.topOfAtmosphere: preserve OPATHFAST source cut/TOA including final synthetic 3 km layer
implementationBoundary.underflow: DEXP semantics with no added epsilon clamp

inputTemplate.atmZGrid: observer altitude as bottom plus AFGLUS levels strictly above it, increasing
inputTemplate.atmosphere: AFGLUS from exact installed libRadtran data
inputTemplate.zout: 0.000000 km relative to the constructed surface

matrixDerivation.aerosolPermutation: flip exact R16 OFF<->DEFAULT mode in every row
matrixDerivation.basis: immutable exact R16 matrix field levels only; no historical comparison/result values
matrixDerivation.geometryAndRole: preserve the ten exact R16 target-altitude/SZA pairs and original 8-development/2-audit role partition
matrixDerivation.observerAltitudePermutation: rotate the exact ten R16 observer-altitude field values forward by 5 row positions
matrixDerivation.wavelengthPermutation: rotate the exact ten R16 wavelength field values forward by 3 row positions
